Never fetched at runtime. The playground (boxes, balls, ragdolls, slingshot,
gravity, the scene that lives in the GIF) is original GifOS chrome around
that engine. Ragdoll proportions and the slingshot elastic follow the
upstream examples (examples/ragdoll.js, examples/slingshot.js), same licence.
